correctness.rationale: Exactly nested horizontal Minkowski sections yield a two-branch full-section formula for every convex base, even when its homothety center is outside the body. Termwise integration of the base mixed-volume polynomial yields the exact two-term recursion and endpoint values. Alexandrov--Fenchel log-concavity with equal endpoint coefficients gives the sharp normalized lower bound, and Minkowski first equality rigidity gives iff centrally symmetric base in dimensions at least three. All difference-body and strict profile assertions follow algebraically. The standalone checker verified 1050 exact rational coefficient identities and 36 independent exact planar section integrals, and a separate 36-case 3D hull comparison agreed; experiments are not proofs.

This is not just a numerical special case or a renamed known inequality.
